Hi team — thanks for the context. I can run the deep-dive; for a full 75–90 minute session with architecture + live demo we should pick a single contiguous window. A few practical notes:
- DST / offsets: right now (early July) the offsets are PDT = UTC-7, CEST = UTC+2, JST = UTC+9. That means a 19:00–20:30 UTC window maps to:
  - 12:00–13:30 PDT (Alice)
  - 21:00–22:30 CEST (Lena) — note this is late for CEST, might be 20:00–21:30 better
  - 04:00–05:30 JST (Haruto) — unfortunately that's very early for JST, so we should avoid windows that push Haruto before 06:00 JST.

Given constraints, here are three options (all 90 min max):
Option A: 16:00–17:30 UTC (09:00–10:30 PDT / 18:00–19:30 CEST / 01:00–02:30 JST) — still early for JST.
Option B: 18:30–20:00 UTC (11:30–13:00 PDT / 20:30–22:00 CEST / 03:30–05:00 JST) — late for CEST and early for JST.
Option C: 06:00–07:30 UTC (23:00–00:30 PDT previous day / 08:00–09:30 CEST / 15:00–16:30 JST) — this is evening for Alice (PDT) and good for EU morning and JP afternoon; seems the most equitable for all timezones.

My recommendation is Option C (06:00–07:30 UTC) because it avoids putting Haruto in the middle of the night and Lena can attend in the morning. I can run at that time on the following dates: Jul 6, Jul 7, Jul 9, Jul 13 (all availability in my calendar). If the customer prefers a later UTC time, we could split the session into a 45-minute architecture call for JP/EU and a separate 45-minute focused demo for US — but a single slot is preferred.

If you want, I’ll propose Option C times to Alice and include a pre-read (short doc) and the deep-dive agenda. I’ll also include a test meeting link and a recorded-demo fallback in case there are bandwidth issues.

- Sean
